d: A reporter tracks down a prince who is in town for the dedication of a naval museum honoring his late grandfather. She convinces him to show his followers that his work is more than just a job, and the two begin to fall for each other.

A dance instructor finds an old photo of a couple who may be her mother and father. Hoping to solve the mystery of her birth family, she travels to Havenshire where she meets a charming prince who dances with her at the Christmas ball.
Unlucky in love Kelly returns home to spend Christmas with her family. With her family’s home at risk of demolition, will the magic of Christmas be enough to save it?
Dumped before Christmas, famous Hollywood actress Olivia secretly returns to her hometown to eat cookies and avoid the press. Instead, she must step up to take the starring role in her own life.

Years after parting ways, former high school sweethearts reunite at their ten-year Christmastime reunion, where they are visited by three ghosts who try to make them reconsider their decision to part ways.

A historian seeks inspiration for her next project in her family's hometown, which is famous for experiencing the Northern Lights. While there, she bonds with a local tour guide who shows her the town's Christmas traditions.

Hotel manager Willow returns to her stunning Virginia hometown to help her sister plan a Christmas wedding at the inn her family once owned. She must work with current owner and single dad David, who wants to let go of the past.

When Olivia goes under cover to report on the popular annual Mistletoe Match event, she meets Thomas, who is just as skeptical about the event as she is. Sparks fly, but she may risk losing a promotion for the romance she never saw coming.
Miranda and Paul, two business rivals who playfully despise each other, work together on a holiday gift-giving app, and unexpected feelings develop for one another.

After leaving her dream job, Maddie returns home for the holidays to reflect. She reconnects with her high school sweetheart, Carter, sparking tensions. Tasked with organizing a Christmas dance, they set aside differences and rekindle old feelings.
